notes:
REF-BM-02: Only the title is collected; description, favicon, and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-03: Title can be edited before and after saving, but no description field exists.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable, but description is absent.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate creation is prevented and the existing item is highlighted, but the user is not taken into editing it.
REF-BM-07: Items expose title and tags, but lack description and favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry provides no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, note, and URL, but no description field exists.
REF-BM-14: Tags are indexed without the # prefix, so #tag queries do not match.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quotes are treated as literal characters rather than exact-phrase syntax.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: No action can target the whole currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: The list is fixed to newest-first with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes are stored and displayed as plain text, not rendered as Markdown.
REF-BM-24: A readable-text extraction is stored in JSON rather than a single-file HTML snapshot, with no PDF handling.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshots are unsupported.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; there is no reversible archive operation to distinguish from it.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are unsupported.
